title: Private VPC Rightsize Workbook — Fleet & BOM Estimator
content:
PURPOSE
Quick workbook to convert customer requirements (QPS, latency SLO, region distribution) into a conservative initial private/VPC deployment BOM and utilization plan. Intended for pre-sales + infra-eng sizing conversations; not final procurement doc.

NOTES TO SELF / CONTEXT
- This is an intentionally conservative starting point for regulated customers that want private VPC deployments.
- Focus: GPU count by region, rack count, network/egress, storage, PDU/power, and 3-year amortized CAPEX/OPEX.
- Keep options for H100 vs A100 vs L40S (customer may prefer cost vs perf).
- Include simple autoscaling headroom and redundancy zones.

ASSUMPTIONS (editable inputs)
- Target overall P99 latency: 250ms for text-gen workloads (streaming enabled).
- Average request size: 512 tokens (input + output) unless customer specifies.
- Peak QPS: INPUT from sales — use sample 120 qps for worked example.
- Concurrency per request: assume 1.5 in-flight per client to cover streaming/keepalives.
- Target sustained GPU utilization: 65% (conservative); allow burst to 90% during short peaks.
- Redundancy: N+1 per region for failover.
- Rack: 8 GPUs per server (typical 4U 4xGPU or 1U 8xGPU depending on SKU).
- Network: 200 Gbps per rack baseline; scale to 400 Gbps for >4 racks per AZ.

INPUTS (example values shown)
- customer_name: "Acme Health"
- target_regions: ["us-west1", "eu-west1"]
- region_split: ["us-west1: 70%", "eu-west1: 30%"]
- peak_qps_global: 120
- avg_tokens_per_request: 512
- model: "open-hybrid-70B-quant" (approx perf profile similar to H100-80B)
- tokens_per_gpu_per_sec (approx): {"H100-80B": 220, "A100-40B": 90, "L40S-70B": 140}
- target_utilization: 0.65

SAMPLE WORKED CALCULATION (per-region breakdown)
Step 1: Convert QPS -> tokens/sec global
- tokens/sec_global = peak_qps_global * avg_tokens_per_request = 120 * 512 = 61,440 tokens/sec
Step 2: Allocate by region (us-west1 70%)
- us-west tokens/sec = 0.7 * 61,440 = 42, [\.\.], wait calculation: 42, , actually do: 42, , messy notes.
- (explicit calc kept simpler for sheet: us-west1 = 42, 
  eu-west1 = 18,432 tokens/sec)
Step 3: GPUs required (per-region) using H100 baseline
- effective_tokens_per_gpu = tokens_per_gpu_per_sec[H100-80B] * target_utilization = 220 * 0.65 ≈ 143 tokens/sec per GPU sustained
- us-west GPUs = ceil(us-west_tokens_per_sec / 143) -> example: 42, 
  (rounded example in sheet: us-west -> 297 GPUs)

NOTE: The numeric placeholders above are intentionally rough in this working doc. Use the calculator tab for precise arithmetic.

SKU PERFORMANCE REFERENCE (editable)
- H100-80B (FP16/AMP) : 220 tokens/sec (high perf, high capex)
- A100-40B : 90 tokens/sec (lower perf, lower capex)
- L40S-70B : 140 tokens/sec (mid perf, lower power)

BOM STUB (per-region) — example us-west1 (final numbers must be computed in sheet)
Columns: SKU | GPUs | Servers | Racks | Estimated unit cost | Subtotal capex | Notes
- H100-80B | 300 GPUs | 75 servers (4xGPU avg) | 10 racks | $60,000/GPU | $18,000,000 | includes NVSwitch variants
- A100-40B | 320 GPUs | 80 servers | 12 racks | $25,000/GPU | $8,000,000 | cheaper per-GPU, more servers

NETWORK & STORAGE
- Switches: 2x 200G leaf + 2x 400G spine per AZ for mid-size deployments (<= 12 racks).
- Storage: 250TB NVMe per region baseline (model checkpoints + logs). Increase to 1PB for multi-model shops.
- Egress: estimate based on request/response sizes * qps * pct_external. Typical: 120 qps * 40KB/resp * 3600s = ~17TB/hr peak — validate with real numbers.

POWER / HVAC & RACKING
- Typical power per GPU-card: H100 ~ 350W, A100 ~ 250W, L40S ~ 300W. Add host + fans ~ 1000W per server.
- Per-rack draw estimate: GPUs_per_rack * power_per_gpu + hosts + switching overhead. Target breaker per rack <= 30kW.

3-YEAR AMORTIZATION (simple)
- CAPEX_total (example) = $18M (HW) + $1.2M (network/storage) + $0.5M (installation) = $19.7M
- Amortized/month = CAPEX_total / 36 ≈ $547k/month
- OPEX estimates: power ($0.12/kWh * estimated_kW * hours), maintenance (10% of CAPEX/yr), staffing (1 dedicated infra eng per X racks)

AUTOSCALING & HEADROOM POLICY
- Baseline: keep 10% spare GPUs for autoscale headroom and 1 region N+1 reserve.
- Scaling policy: scale out in increments of 8 GPUs (1 server) with automated warm-up and KV cache pre-warming for popular prefixes.

RISK & OPEN QUESTIONS
- Exact tokens/sec per GPU varies by model and sequence length distribution — need profiling runs with customer prompt sets.
- PCIe vs NVLink topology impacts perf and server GPU density (clarify with hardware vendor).
- Procurement lead times: H100 variants currently 12–20 weeks; A100 8–12 weeks—impact planning.

ACTION ITEMS (next steps)
- [ ] Run profiler on customer prompt set to produce tokens/sec distribution (owner: Liam).
- [ ] Replace placeholder numeric examples with computed results from the calculator tab (owner: Asha).
- [ ] Confirm preferred GPU SKU with customer and security (Noah).
- [ ] Raise a procurement pre-approval ticket: JIRA-PV-299.

QUICK CHECKLIST FOR SALES CALL
- Ask for peak and average QPS, percent streaming, target latency P50/P95/P99, regional presence, data residency rules, acceptable SKUs, and budget range.
- Confirm whether customer needs on-prem (air-gapped) vs VPC-connected private control plane.

REFERENCES & LINKS
- Confluence: architecture notes for private deployments CONFLUENCE-12345
- Sample perf runs: github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/blob/main/private/2025-h100-profiles.md
- Procurement SLA: vendor-lead-times Q4-2025 spreadsheet

---
This is intentionally a lightweight, editable workbook doc. The numbers above are illustrative; the sheet tab should contain the detailed arithmetic, rounding rules (ceil to server granularity), and final per-region BOM with PDU/power/space/cost breakdown.

END OF SHEET
